market_question: Will Liverpool finish in the top 4 of the EPL 2025–26 standings?
reasoning: Liverpool are a perennial top‑4 contender with a deep squad and strong recent finishes. Under Arne Slot they led the 2024‑25 league at the halfway point. Though competition remains fierce and one season is a small sample, their fundamental quality makes a 70% top‑4 probability plausible, well above the market’s 52.5%.
evidence_points: Liverpool finished 3rd in 2023‑24 and were top of the table in December 2024 under Slot.
Squad retains key performers (Salah, van Dijk, Alisson) and has renewed midfield depth.
Since 2016‑17 they missed the top four only once (2022‑23), quickly recovering afterward.
sources_consulted: Current 2024‑25 league table and performance metrics
Squad composition and managerial stability assessments
